title: वीपी कोइरालाको राजनीतिक प्रस्थानविन्दु BP Koiralako Rajnitik Prasthan Bindu
nepali: इतिहासको कालखण्डमा विश्वसमुदायमा विभिन्न पक्षको परिवर्तन भएको देखिन्छ । भौगोलिकताबाहेक हरेक विषयमा विभिन्न किसिमका गतिविधि भएर राजनीतिक तथा प्रशासनिक परिवर्तन भएका पाइन्छन् । नेपालमा पनि नेपाली जनताका छोराबाट परिवर्तनको विजारोपण गरिएको परिवर्तनको सन्दर्भसँग प्रस्तुत लेख आबद्ध छ । प्रजातान्त्रिक राजनीतिक परिवर्तनबाट वाक् स्वतन्त्रता, सामाजिक न्याय, लोककल्याणकारी राज्य व्यवस्थाको स्थापना, सम्पत्ति तथा सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा, व्यक्तिगत स्वतन्त्रता प्राप्त हुने देखिन्छ । जनताको विश्वासबाट मात्रै उपर्युक्त विषयहरू सम्बोधन गर्नसक्ने नेतृत्व आउन सक्दछ । तसर्थ जगत्को चाहनाअनुसार राजनीतिक रूपान्तरणका लागि विचार निर्माण गर्नु र जनताको बीचमा रहन पनि जनताकै भलाइका लागि काम गर्न आवश्यक छ । यसैका लागि वीपी कोइरालाले राजनीतिक वातावरणको अभावका बावजुद पनि नयाँ राजनीतिक खाका कोरे, जुन राजनीतिक स्वतन्त्रताको आधार बन्यो ।
american_english: Over historical epochs, changes across various dimensions are seen to have taken place within the global community. Except for geography, political and administrative changes are found to have occurred through various kinds of activities in every subject. In Nepal as well, this article is connected with the context of change seeded by a son of the Nepali people. Through democratic political change, freedom of speech, social justice, the establishment of a welfare state system, property and public security, and personal liberty are seen to be attained. Only through the trust of the people can leadership emerge that is capable of addressing the aforementioned matters. Therefore, it is necessary to formulate ideas for political transformation in accordance with the world's aspirations, and, while remaining among the people, to work for the people's own well-being. For this very purpose, despite the lack of a favorable political environment, BP Koirala sketched a new political blueprint, which became the foundation of political freedom.

Except for geography, there have been all sorts of moves in every area bringing about political and administrative changes. In Nepal as well, this article ties straight into the change planted by a son of the Nepali people. From democratic political change, you get freedom of speech, social justice, a proper welfare state up and running, security for property and the public, and individual freedom. Only through the trust of the people can a leadership come up that can actually sort out these matters. For this exact reason, even without a proper political environment, BP Koirala drew up a fresh political blueprint, and that became the foundation for political freedom.
